title: Week 13 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “simple interest”?
options: A provision directing disputes to private arbitration rather than court, subject to law.
A contract granting temporary use of property under stated terms.
Revolving debt balance relative to available revolving credit.
Interest calculated only on principal.
questions.explanation: Simple interest means interest calculated only on principal.
choices: A provision directing disputes to private arbitration rather than court, subject to law.
A contract granting temporary use of property under stated terms.
Revolving debt balance relative to available revolving credit.
Interest calculated only on principal.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “compound interest”?
options: A notice asking creditors to take additional identity-verification steps.
Capacity to absorb shocks and continue meeting essential obligations.
A recurring cost that is relatively stable during the planning period.
Interest calculated on principal plus previously credited interest.
questions.explanation: Compound interest means interest calculated on principal plus previously credited interest.
choices: A notice asking creditors to take additional identity-verification steps.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “future value”?
options: Protection against specified claims that the insured caused injury or damage to another.
The amount a current sum is expected to grow to under stated assumptions.
An individual retirement account with tax treatment defined by current law, often involving tax-deferred growth.
The maximum amount an insurer will pay under a provision.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “present value”?
options: Earnings before deductions.
Failure to make a required payment on time.
The current equivalent of a future sum discounted at a stated rate.
Funds held by a third party for taxes, insurance, or transaction conditions.
questions.explanation: Present value means the current equivalent of a future sum discounted at a stated rate.
choices: Earnings before deductions.
Failure to make a required payment on time.
The current equivalent of a future sum discounted at a stated rate.
Funds held by a third party for taxes, insurance, or transaction conditions.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “nominal return”?
options: A plan for allocating expected income among spending, saving, giving, debt, and goals.
Return measured before adjusting for inflation.
A tax based on taxable income under applicable law.
A person legally obligated in specified circumstances to act in another’s best interest.
questions.explanation: Nominal return means return measured before adjusting for inflation.
choices: A plan for allocating expected income among spending, saving, giving, debt, and goals.
Return measured before adjusting for inflation.
A tax based on taxable income under applicable law.
A person legally obligated in specified circumstances to act in another’s best interest.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “real return”?
options: A tax imposed on specified purchases.
The maximum amount an insurer will pay under a provision.
Property value minus debt secured by the property.
Return after adjusting for inflation.
questions.explanation: Real return means return after adjusting for inflation.
choices: A tax imposed on specified purchases.
The maximum amount an insurer will pay under a provision.
Property value minus debt secured by the property.
Return after adjusting for inflation.
